title: TxAuthorizationV1
description: One authorization outcome for one transaction, dated when the authorization system decided. Topic tx.authorization.v1, keyed by account_id and deduplicated by payload.transaction_id. A transaction's own outcome never reaches its own features (ADR-0049).

transaction_id.description: The transaction this outcome belongs to: the same value as its tx.raw.v1 payload.transaction_id.

authorization_outcome.description: What the authorization system decided. UNKNOWN carries no observation and REVERSED is a later event with other semantics, so neither is an outcome here.

transaction_occurred_at.description: The transaction's event time, copied. The envelope's occurred_at is the outcome time.
